description: A Dart class providing CRUD operations for 'todos' using Supabase in a Flutter app.

classes.name: TodoService
classes.description: Service class for managing 'todos' in the database via Supabase.

methods.name: getTodos
methods.description: Fetches all 'todo' records from the database.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Inserts a new 'todo' record with the specified title.

methods.name: updateTodoStatus
methods.description: Updates the 'is_done' status of a 'todo' by its ID.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Deletes a 'todo' record by its ID.
